question: Can I grow rice on this field?

Annual rainfall: optimal 1500-2000 mm, tolerated 1000-4000 mm.
Soil depth: optimal medium (50-150 cm); tolerated shallow (20-50 cm).
Soil fertility: optimal high; tolerated moderate.
Light: optimal very bright; tolerated cloudy skies to very bright.

answer:
Growing rice on this field is poorly suited, with a suitability score of 13 out of 100 [S1]. The primary limitations are the soil pH and drainage conditions [S1]. 

Rice prefers an optimal soil pH of 5.5 to 7 [S2], whereas the field's soil pH is 8.8 according to the SSURGO soil survey [S1]. Additionally, rice thrives in poorly drained soils that remain saturated for more than 50% of the year [S2], but this parcel is classified as well drained [S1]. Furthermore, the regional climate has a mean annual rainfall of 288 mm (ERA5 reanalysis (ECMWF), daily aggregates, 25 km pixel, modelled, 2006-2025), which is far below rice's optimal annual rainfall requirement of 1500 to 2000 mm [S2].
